user.title: Connect to Dishes
user.description: Enter your Dishes app URL and an integration token. Create the token in Dishes under Settings → Integrations. It needs `read:meal_plan`; add `read:cooking` for who's cooking and timers, and `read:shopping_list` + `write:shopping_list` for the shopping list.

data_description.url: Base URL of your Dishes app, e.g. https://dishes.home.example.com
data_description.token: A token with at least the read:meal_plan scope

reauth_confirm.title: Dishes token needed
reauth_confirm.description: Dishes at {url} turned the token down — it was revoked or has expired. Create a new one in Dishes under Settings → Integrations.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Dishes
reconfigure.description: Change the Dishes address, or swap in a new token — say, one with more scopes.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Dishes. Check the URL and that the app is running.
error.missing_scope: The token is missing the read:meal_plan scope.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Dishes instance is already configured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to fetch the meal plan, in minutes. It's also fetched just after midnight.
data_description.cooking_interval: How often to check who's cooking, in seconds. Timer sensors are exact either way.
